This is a straightforward, benign informational query about how machine learning can improve decision-making — no harm-adjacent or distasteful content is involved, so the specialized moderation desensitization that distinguishes the two models is irrelevant here.

Given that, I routed on general capability. Dunlin-235B outperforms Lapwing-235B across the board: higher public benchmarks (MMLU-Pro 81.2 vs 74.8, GPQA Diamond 64.1 vs 54.3, Arena-Hard 90.6 vs 81.4) and higher internal eval scores on the relevant dimensions (Creative Generation, Summarization, Support Dialogue) by margins well beyond run-to-run variance. For an open-ended, insight-oriented explanatory request like this, the stronger general-purpose model is the better fit.
